Pain_Point: No website; patients cannot find clinic online; no appointment system; competitor clinic has better GMB listing
Best_Outreach_Method: WhatsApp voice note + in-person visit during slow hours (2-4pm)
Notes: Look for clinics with GMB listing but no website link. Offer appointment booking page + AI FAQ bot as key feature.

Pain_Point: No professional website; relies on word-of-mouth only; cannot showcase services and expertise to new clients
Best_Outreach_Method: WhatsApp + referral through mutual business contacts or CA associations
Notes: Target smaller CA firms (not Big 4 type). CAs are credibility-driven — show professional portfolio samples. GST season (Jan-March) is busy; avoid pitching then.

Pain_Point: No online menu; not visible on Google Search; customers cannot check timings or book a table online
Best_Outreach_Method: In-person visit + Instagram DM with sample of what their site could look like
Notes: Target restaurants with 50+ Google reviews (proven demand) but no website. Online menu + GMB integration + WhatsApp order inquiry is compelling for them.

Pain_Point: No website; students/parents find them only via pamphlets; competitor institutes have enrollment pages online
Best_Outreach_Method: WhatsApp to owner + visit during enrollment season (April-June and Oct-Nov)
Notes: Enrollment season is the trigger moment. Offer student enrollment form + course listing + results showcase. Multilingual site (English + Gujarati) preferred.

Pain_Point: Listed on IndiaMART but no company website; international buyers cannot verify company credibility online; losing export inquiries
Best_Outreach_Method: In-person GIDC visit + email to listed IndiaMART contact
Notes: Check IndiaMART listings without website URL — these are ready prospects. Emphasize export credibility and B2B inquiry form. Higher budget but longer sales cycle.

Pain_Point: No way for clients to book appointments online; relies on phone calls; no portfolio of work visible online
Best_Outreach_Method: Instagram DM with sample portfolio website + WhatsApp follow-up
Notes: Target salons active on Instagram but without a website. Online booking + before/after gallery is the hook. Female business owners — adjust communication style accordingly.

Pain_Point: New CA firm struggling to establish credibility; no digital presence; seniors have all the clients
Best_Outreach_Method: LinkedIn + local CA association events + WhatsApp
Notes: Young CA professionals understand digital value. Budget-conscious but can be upsold to AMC. First mover in their area = good long-term relationship.

Pain_Point: Customers cannot find store hours or contact online; losing walk-in customers to chains that have GMB + website
Best_Outreach_Method: In-person walk-in pitch with printed sample page for a pharmacy
Notes: Very price-sensitive. Offer a simple 3-page informational site (Home + Services + Contact). Upsell: WhatsApp catalog for home delivery. Avoid complex features.

Pain_Point: No portfolio website to share with prospective clients; losing inquiries to decorators with Instagram websites
Best_Outreach_Method: Instagram DM with visual demo + WhatsApp voice note
Notes: Visual businesses need portfolio galleries. Offer high-speed image gallery + WhatsApp quote request form. Peak season: Nov-Feb (wedding season in Gujarat).

Pain_Point: No online catalog for out-of-state buyers; WhatsApp catalog gets cluttered and unorganized; buyers keep asking for PDF catalogs
Best_Outreach_Method: In-person visit to market shop + WhatsApp follow-up
Notes: Surat textile traders sell across India. A digital catalog website + WhatsApp inquiry button solves their biggest daily headache. Highlight time saved sending PDFs.

Pain_Point: Patients searching 'dentist near me' go to competitors; no online consultation or appointment request; no treatment cost transparency
Best_Outreach_Method: WhatsApp to clinic doctor + visit during non-patient hours (1-3pm)
Notes: Dentists have high margins per procedure. One implant/root canal case pays for the entire website. Perfect ROI pitch.

Pain_Point: High-ticket projects (₹3L–₹25L) but no website to showcase completed residential/commercial projects; clients demand portfolio
Best_Outreach_Method: LinkedIn / Instagram DM with bespoke demo portfolio + WhatsApp
Notes: High average order value means a ₹30,000 website is a no-brainer investment for them. Highlight project case studies and 3D render showcase.
